definitions.explanation: The dried or fresh leaves of the tea plant used to brew tea. Refers to the leaves themselves rather than the prepared beverage.

examples.japanese: {茶葉|ちゃば}を{急須|きゅうす}に{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Put the tea leaves in the teapot.

examples.japanese: この{茶葉|ちゃば}は{静岡|しずおか}{産|さん}の{上質|じょうしつ}なものだ。
examples.english: These tea leaves are high-quality ones from Shizuoka.

examples.japanese: {茶葉|ちゃば}の{量|りょう}やお{湯|ゆ}の{温度|おんど}で{味|あじ}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The flavor changes greatly depending on the amount of tea leaves and the water temperature.

notes:
{茶葉|ちゃば} refers to tea leaves — the dried or fresh leaves of the tea plant, used to brew tea. A compound of {茶|ちゃ} (tea) + {葉|ば} (leaf).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶葉|ちゃば}を{蒸|む}す: to steam tea leaves
- {茶葉|ちゃば}の{産地|さんち}: tea-producing region
- {上質|じょうしつ}な{茶葉|ちゃば}: high-quality tea leaves
- {茶葉|ちゃば}を{保存|ほぞん}する: to store tea leaves
- {茶葉|ちゃば}を{急須|きゅうす}に{入|い}れる: to put tea leaves in the teapot

USAGE:
Used when discussing tea varieties, preparation methods, or purchasing. Major tea-producing regions in Japan include {静岡|しずおか}, {京都|きょうと} ({宇治|うじ}), and {鹿児島|かごしま}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {茶葉|ちゃば}: the leaves themselves (raw material)
- お{茶|ちゃ}: the prepared beverage, or tea in general
